formula: delta L_R = E_A delta Y_R^A + nabla_mu Theta_R^mu(delta Y_R)
owned_if: L_R is selected with field normalization, derivative order, density convention, and boundary class
claim_effect: defines the upstream object needed for Q_R, B_R, K_boundary, and no-hair identities

formula: Theta_R^mu(delta Y)=Pi_A^mu delta Y^A, Pi_A^mu := partial L_R / partial(nabla_mu Y^A)
owned_if: L_R has no higher derivatives or higher-derivative boundary terms have been reduced by auxiliary fields
claim_effect: turns a chosen L_R into a computable symplectic potential

formula: Theta_R^mu=sum_{r=0}^{N-1} Pi_A^{mu alpha_1...alpha_r} nabla_{alpha_1}...nabla_{alpha_r} delta Y^A
owned_if: finite derivative order N and all corner/counterterm conventions are declared
claim_effect: fixes which epsilon_R jets must vanish for proper boundary silence

formula: insert delta_epsilon Y^A=R^A_AB epsilon^AB + R^{A mu}_AB nabla_mu epsilon^AB + ... into Theta_R; P_R^{mu AB} is the coefficient package whose divergence enters C_R^AB
owned_if: v_R action on every parent field and tensor/density convention for C_R are fixed
claim_effect: connects Theta_R to B_R^AB=sigma n_mu P_R^{mu AB}+...

formula: L_R=-1/2 Z_R <nabla R,nabla R> -1/2 M_R^2 <R,R> + <J_R,R> gives Theta_R^mu=-Z_R <nabla^mu R,delta R> plus projector terms
owned_if: R_AB really is the retained local amplitude, Z_R>0, M_R^2>0, J_R and boundary data are source-owned
claim_effect: if J_R=0 and boundary flux=0, no-hair can set R_AB=0; otherwise alpha(lambda) is live

formula: Theta_R/P_R template is mathematically ready, but no parent R_AB block is selected or proved
